partners.mechanism_chain: GRK1 (HGNC:4578) —DISRUPTS→ Rhodopsin desensitization and signaling (GO:0007604); Rhodopsin desensitization and signaling (GO:0007604) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal dysfunction (HP:0000503); GUCY2D (HGNC:4703) —DISRUPTS→ Retinoid cycle and photoreceptor homeostasis (GO:0007604); Retinoid cycle and photoreceptor homeostasis (GO:0007604) —LEADS_TO→ Leber congenital amaurosis (HP:0000503). Loss-of-function mutations in GRK1 disrupt rhodopsin desensitization and signaling, leading to retinal dysfunction in BBS. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in GUCY2D disrupt the retinoid cycle and photoreceptor homeostasis, causing Leber congenital amaurosis.
